title: Intervention-logic proposal (HYPOTHESIS ONLY)
claim_class: Every item below is a structural/directional HYPOTHESIS derived from the threshold read. None is a treatment, a molecule, a dose, an efficacy result, or a safety result. All clinical magnitudes are [O] OPEN and require laboratory and clinical validation the author does not perform.

proposals.statement: Intervene at the nociceptor-restricted firing gate in the peripheral sensory neuron, rather than at a central site.
proposals.basis: The threshold map locates the gate in nociceptor-restricted effectors (the Na_V triad and the TRP transducers); the channelopathy anchor shows DNA changes there move pain in a firing-threshold direction.

proposals.statement: Move the gate in the direction that raises the effective firing threshold and restores the OFF basin; do not abolish protective high-threshold nociception.
proposals.basis: Pathological pole = threshold lowered / barrier reduced (GOF channelopathy); protective pole = high threshold (CIP at the limit). The aim is a controlled return toward the protective pole, not its overshoot.

proposals.statement: Rank candidate effectors by nociceptor-selectivity combined with their place in the threshold map; pursue the Na_V triad as the primary axis (Na_V1.8 highest peripheral selectivity, then Na_V1.9, then Na_V1.7), with TRPV1 and TRPA1 as the transduction arm.
proposals.basis: Selectivity is the cited Layer-2 biology; the map supplies the reproducible read ordering. Na_V1.8 is the most nociceptor-restricted and is the realised case.

proposals.statement: Prefer a state-dependent mode of action that stabilises the closed or inactivated channel state, because that is the shape that raises the firing threshold while leaving normal low-frequency conduction largely intact.
proposals.basis: This is the structural shape the approved Na_V1.8 case exhibits (closed-state stabilisation at VSD2). It is named here as a design SHAPE, not a molecule.
proposals.grade: [F] structural mechanism shape; any molecule realising it is [O]

proposals.statement: Because the targeted gate is peripheral and nociceptor-restricted, this direction is pursued as an opioid alternative that structurally does not engage central reward circuitry; whether any given molecule actually achieves analgesia, selectivity, or an improved liability profile is an open empirical question, not a claim made here.
proposals.basis: Structural rationale only. The empirical outcome for any candidate is [O] and must be established by proper preclinical and clinical work.

proposals.statement: Pursue pain-selective local anaesthesia by pairing a nociceptor-selective entry port (TRPV1 or TRPA1) with a charged, firing-threshold-raising blocker that can only reach its site by passing through that open port, so that the resulting block is differential: nociceptive fibres are silenced while motor and light-touch fibres are largely spared.
proposals.basis: The precision map pairs the cited nociceptor-selective transducers (TRPV1, TRPA1) with the Na_V firing-threshold raisers from the threshold read; the differential-block mechanism SHAPE is anchored to Binshtok, Bean and Woolf (Nature 2007). The differential-block ratio, duration, concentration, and any formulation are [O] OPEN and are not asserted here.
proposals.grade: [F] structural mechanism shape (entry-port selectivity x charged blocker); differential-block magnitude [O]

explicit_non_claims: No molecule is designed or named as a proposed drug.
No synthesis, formulation, or manufacturing route is provided.
No dose, regimen, or route of administration is provided.
No efficacy, potency, safety, or pharmacokinetic result is asserted.
Nothing here diagnoses, treats, cures, or prevents any condition, and no patient should act on it.
